advisories.vulnerable_operation: Unbounded brace expansion can exhaust memory.
advisories.agrowai_reachability: Used by Jest glob matching and Expo fingerprint/build tooling; not imported by the mobile runtime graph.
advisories.remediation: npm update brace-expansion postcss applied the compatible in-range versions; no force or major downgrade.

advisories.vulnerable_operation: Attacker-controlled sourceMappingURL may load and disclose a local source-map file when PostCSS processes untrusted CSS without a safe from value.
advisories.agrowai_reachability: Used by Tailwind/NativeWind and Expo Metro configuration while transforming trusted repository styles; not imported by application runtime code.
advisories.remediation: npm update brace-expansion postcss applied postcss@8.5.26 within compatible ranges.

review_note: The remaining npm advisories are moderate and outside the two requested high-severity gates; no force remediation was used.
